name: Feature request
about: A new capability, or a change to how something already works
type: Feature
---

## Summary

<!--
Two to four plain sentences: what should be possible that is not today, and who
it is for (users, admins, operators). Describe behavior, not code: no file
paths, links to files, or function names. Keep Summary, Impact, and Evidence
under 150 words together.
-->

## Impact

<!-- One line: what gets better once this exists, and for whom. -->

## Evidence

<!--
Why it is wanted: who asked for it, the problem it solves, or what people do
today instead. Say what you have not confirmed.
-->

## Recommendations

<!--
One or more proposed solutions, as a numbered list. For each, say in one or two
sentences what would change and what it costs or risks. Put the one you would
pick first and say why. Describe the approach, not code: no file paths or
function names. Say what you have not checked.
-->
